title: Open a demo account
summary: Install MetaTrader, open a [[demo-account]], and learn to tell a demo account from a real one before you practise.

steps.text: Install the MetaTrader app from the Play Store. Use whichever version your chosen broker supports.
steps.mt4: Search the Play Store for MetaTrader 4.
steps.mt5: Search the Play Store for MetaTrader 5.

steps.text: Open the app and go to its accounts screen. Choose the option to open a new demo account.
Pick a broker's demo server. If you are not sure which one, choose a broker you have checked is regulated where you live.
Fill in the demo form. A demo account never needs a deposit or card details. If you are asked for payment, stop: you are not opening a demo.
Write down the login number and password the app shows, and keep them private.
On the accounts screen, look for a label or server name that says the account is a demo. If you cannot tell, do not place any trades until you are sure.
Open the Quotes tab and check that prices are showing. Your demo account is ready.

afterQuestions.prompt: How much money did you need to deposit to open the demo account?

options.explanation: Right: a demo account uses pretend money, so no deposit is ever needed.

options.text: A small deposit to activate it
options.explanation: No: if a demo asks for a deposit, it is not a demo. Stop and check what you are signing up for.

afterQuestions.prompt: You open MetaTrader and are not sure whether the account is demo or real. What should you do?

options.text: Place a small trade and see what happens
options.explanation: No: on a real account even a small trade risks real money.

options.text: Check the accounts screen for the demo label before trading
options.explanation: Right: always confirm you are on demo before any practice trade.
